messages:
Samira K: Hey docs — quick heads up, I'm opening a PR to add example dashboard JSONs for cost/latency breakdowns and a small tracing hook example. Need a quick review and someone to run the linkcheck job before merge.
Ben Lee: Thanks! PR link?
Samira K: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/482 — contains: /console/monitoring/dashboards/examples/*.json, tracing/hook-snippets.md small snippet, and a redirect for an old link. Also updated README with migration notes.
Jia Wu: I'll take the dashboard samples. Any specific workload configs we should include? short, bursty, long-tail.
Samira K: Good call — added three: small-dev, steady-prod, high-throughput-bursty. Each has token distribution and recommended batching settings in comments.
Marco D: I'll validate the tracing snippet. Quick note: our tracing library changed API; need to swap trace.start_span -> trace.startSpan
Samira K: ack — fixed in commit 7c9d. Also added a fenced code block: 
```js
// tracing hook example
const span = trace.startSpan('inference');
span.setAttribute('model', 'redwood/longform-v1');
await span.end();
```
Ben Lee: Linkcheck failed on CI — 404 for /console/old-monitoring-guide. I can add a redirect rule in netlify config if we want to keep old path.
Samira K: Prefer adding a redirect and updating inbound links. Can you add the redirect? small change.
Ben Lee: On it. Will push netlify redirect rule to pr branch.
DocsBot: linkcheck report: 1 broken link (details: /console/old-monitoring-guide) — status: open
Jia Wu: I reviewed sample small-dev dashboard. Two small suggestions: reduce default query window to 5m and add note about cache warmup.
Samira K: Updated. Also added a short migration note under /console/migration/tracing-v2.md explaining the startSpan change and config key rename batching.window_ms -> batching.window_ms (typo fix).
Marco D: LGTM for tracing snippet. One minor nit: use async/await pattern in example for clarity.
Samira K: changed snippet per nit. Ready for final review.
Ben Lee: Redirect added and CI re-run.
DocsBot: CI passed: 0 failures, linkcheck passed.
Samira K: Great — merging in 15m if no objections. Thanks team :tada:
Jia Wu: :+1:
Marco D: :shipit:
